items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: And I said, “That’s Billy Cobham, and he’s doing that on a four-piece drum set.”

ctx.x: There’s a weird loop to that thing.

Yeah. And I just said to this young man, I said, do you realize what you just said? Do you wear the same clothes every day? Do you have the same conversations every day? I mean damn. And the other trick that I would use with them is I put on, I had a deal with my students. They’d give me the stuff they’re listening to, all the current stuff, and I hip them to the stuff that I grew up with when I was their age. So I put on Mahavishnu “Inner Mounting Flame.” Billy Cobham. And this kid goes, “God, who is that?” And…
